title: MultiInput
description: Fiori multi input: a text field with tokens, value help and suggestions, plus the SAP token keyboard model.

usage.summary: Collect several values as caller-managed tokens, with suggestions and optional value help.
useWhen: Let users collect several free-form or application-validated values, including choices from datasets above 200.
Offer suggestions or connect a separate value-help surface when users need help identifying an entry.
Keep creation and validation of tokens in the application; the field does not choose a predefined option set for the caller.
Create tokens in onCommit, supply tokens and handle onTokenDelete; showValueHelpIcon and onValueHelpTrigger connect a caller-supplied surface.

avoidWhen.when: Select only predefined options from fewer than 200 values and let the control manage selected option tokens.
Collect one value: use Input for free text with optional suggestions, ComboBox for type-ahead across 20–200, or Select for 2–12 fixed options without typing (sort alphabetically above 8).
Provide the actual search across several attributes or condition editor, especially above 200 entries; the field only opens the caller-supplied surface.
Inspect and remove existing tokens without entering new values.
